# Madgrowth

> Madgrowth helps leaders in tech with 5 to 10+ years of experience turn that experience into a business they own: a fractional role, a services or advisory business, or software. It's run by Madalena Rugeroni: ex-Google, advisor and investor, who scaled startups from zero to $10M in revenue and runs a portfolio of internet businesses, including the software company Mazo. Madalena also advises startup founders from 0 to $1M in revenue on go-to-market.

Experienced operators usually have the credibility to go independent. Where they get stuck is the offer: what to sell, who buys it, how to package it and what to charge. Madgrowth works on exactly that, either self-serve with AI skills or 1:1 with Madalena. Prices are in euros.

## Offers for leaders in tech

- [The Builder Diagnostic](https://www.madgrowth.io/diagnostic/): Free, about 3 minutes. Short scenarios that identify your Builder Archetype (Broadcaster, Advisor, Productizer, Venture Builder or Orchestrator) and which business models fit how you work. Includes the free Expertise Audit skill by email, which finds your three strongest angles from your career.
- [The Stack](https://www.madgrowth.io/stack/): 299€ one-time. Fifteen AI skills for Claude that work as one system. A setup skill classifies your business (services, software, product, local, media, marketplaces), then each skill applies the playbook for that model and ends with a document: customer interviews, ICP, positioning, messaging, offer, pricing, unit economics, go/no-go, founder content, lead magnet, landing page, launch plan, customer acquisition, conversion and retention. Playbooks draw on April Dunford, Blair Enns, Alex Hormozi, Bob Moesta, Madhavan Ramanujam, David C. Baker and others.
- [The Audit](https://www.madgrowth.io/#audit): 599€ one-time. A written diagnosis, delivered within 5 business days of confirming the intake, that scores your angle, positioning, offer, audience and launch plan, with a 90-day roadmap and a direct verdict. Credited toward The Build within 14 days.
- [The Build](https://www.madgrowth.io/#build): 1,200€ a month, 3-month minimum. 1:1 with Madalena to position, package, price and launch in 90 days. Two 60-minute sessions a month, unlimited chat between sessions, reviews of your positioning, offer page, site and launch plan, and The Stack included. Limited to 10 active clients.

## Offer for startup founders

- [Startup Go-to-Market Advisory](https://www.madgrowth.io/startups/): 3,000€ a month, 3-month minimum. For founders from 0 to $1M in revenue, any kind of startup. Up to four sessions a month plus unlimited chat, covering positioning, pricing, ICP, demand and a repeatable path to revenue. Mazo is included for B2B SaaS companies. Five founders at a time. Starts with a free 15-minute call.

## Who it's for

- Directors, VPs, heads of growth, product and engineering leaders, and consultants with 5 to 10+ years in tech who want more autonomy and something of their own.
- People still employed, recently independent, or already building a product.
- Not a course, not a job marketplace and not a community.
